method: Headed production Chromium; click listener and two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; PerformanceObserver longtask, event and layout-shift. Per-action jank and layout shift use the next 500 ms, including shifts following recent input; this is a diagnostic window, not causal attribution or CLS.
